synthesizedFacts.fact: Persistent eczema flares often stem from a weakened skin barrier, hidden irritants or allergens, under-moisturizing, insufficient treatment, infection, or stress.
Common triggers for eczema flare-ups include allergens, environmental factors, internal factors like stress, and external factors such as certain medications and irritants.
Genetic factors, such as mutations in the filaggrin gene, can contribute to recurring eczema by affecting the skin barrier.
